title: DPDP (Amendment) Rules, 2026 - erasure timeline
text: In partial modification of the earlier rules, a data fiduciary shall erase personal data within 30 days of receiving a verified erasure request or withdrawal of consent, including copies held by processors.

title: RBI - Grievance redressal timeline for regulated entities
text: RBI directs regulated entities to resolve customer complaints within 21 days and display the grievance officer details in their app and website.

title: RBI Digital Lending (Amendment) Directions - cooling-off period
text: Regulated entities shall give borrowers a cooling-off period within 5 days of disbursal to exit a digital loan without penalty, paying only the principal and proportionate APR.

title: CERT-In - Cyber incident reporting timeline
text: Service providers and intermediaries shall report cyber incidents to CERT-In within 4 hours of noticing them.
